newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Chairman to propose Koor shed holdings.
newsitem.headline: Chairman to propose Koor shed holdings.

text.p: Shamrock Holdings Ltd will propose Israel's Koor Industries spin off its biggest publicly traded subsidiaries to shareholders, Stanley Gold, Shamrock's president and Koor's chairman, said on Thursday.

"We haven't formally proposed anything to the board, but we have suggested it both to Bank Hapoalim and to management," Gold told Reuters, confirming rumours in the Israeli media of the last two days. Hapoalim is Koor's single biggest shareholder.

Gold, whose Shamrock Holdings is Koor's second biggest shareholder with a stake of about 20 percent, said he wanted the holding company to spin off its shares in Tadiran Ltd, Makhteshim Chemical Works, and Makhteshim's Agan Chemical Manufacturers subsidiary.
